conversationBackend.description: Who leads the spoken conversation: the local pipeline or Qwen Audio over the Alibaba Token Plan (wake word, speaker check and voice stay local).

conversationConsent.description: The owner agreed that speech and conversation content go to Alibaba Cloud (Qwen Audio, Token Plan); missing or false keeps the conversation local.

conversationSilenceSeconds.description: Silence after an answer until the conversation ends and the wake word is needed again; missing means 20.

proactiveAnnouncements.description: Friday speaks background results on her own; false holds them until the owner's next request. Missing means true.

conversationRegion.description: Alibaba Cloud region of the Token Plan used by Qwen Audio (international Singapore or mainland China); must match where the key was issued. Missing means ap-southeast-1.
